goal: I am a Harborstone Insurance customer and recently purchased a new vessel. Please review my existing marine policy, check whether the new vessel can be added, determine coverage impact, estimate the premium change, identify required information, and give me the final next steps.

plan.goal: I am a Harborstone Insurance customer and recently purchased a new vessel. Please review my existing marine policy, check whether the new vessel can be added, determine coverage impact, estimate the premium change, identify required information, and give me the final next steps.

tasks.instruction: Retrieve the customer's existing policies using the provided customer_id.
Check the eligibility of the new vessel for addition to the marine policy using the vessel's type, year built, and value.
Estimate the premium change for adding the new vessel to the policy using the current premium from the relevant policy and the new vessel's type and value.
Retrieve the required policy-update requirements for the new vessel using its type and value.

Synthesize the results from the previous tasks to provide a comprehensive review of the existing marine policy, determine if the new vessel can be added, assess coverage impact, estimate the premium change, identify required information, and provide the final next steps for the customer.
